fields.summary_ko.0: Jefferies raised Eli Lilly (LLY) price target from $1,610 to $1,700, marking Wall Street's highest target; stock gained 2.35% to $1,385.56 in premarket trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: Jefferies emphasized international obesity treatment market size and GLP-1 new drug portfolio, noting non-U.S. markets could reach parity or exceed domestic market scale.
